evidence: Each launch assumption in tests/test.sh maps to a public statement. (1) Entry: test.sh:68 'if [[ ! -f /app/server.js ]]' and :111 'node "$APP_ENTRY"' <-> integration.md:3 'Put the finished app in /app. I start it with node /app/server.js'. (2) Working directory: tests/Dockerfile:45 'WORKDIR /tests' (launch cwd is not /app) <-> integration.md:3 'from a working directory that may be outside /app. Resolve files from their actual location.' (3) Port and bind: test.sh:108 'PORT="3000"', probes on 127.0.0.1:3000, prompts use http://localhost:3000 <-> integration.md:3 'Listen on port 3000 on 0.0.0.0 (PORT is set to 3000 at launch)'. (4) Liveness: test.sh:48 'for url in ("http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/health", "http://127.0.0.1:3000/")' with a 120 x 0.25 s window, any HTTP response accepted <-> integration.md:3 'serve the workspace at / and answer GET /api/health promptly'; instruction.md:5 'serve the workspace at /'. (5) Database: test.sh:98,101,109 'DB_PATH="$APP_DB"' being /app/app.db or /tmp/submission/app.db when /app is not writable <-> integration.md:9 'The default database path is /app/app.db. If DB_PATH is set, open that absolute path instead, including when the app runs from a writable copy outside /app.' Restart helper relaunches with the same DB_PATH (test.sh:160-167) <-> integration.md:7,9 'survive ... complete process restarts'. (6) Dependencies: test.sh:106 'NODE_PATH="/usr/local/lib/node_modules"'; tests/Dockerfile:20-21 and environment/Dockerfile:10-11 both pin 'express@5.1.0' and 'better-sqlite3@12.4.1' on Node 22 <-> integration.md:5 'The launch image supplies Node 22, Express and better-sqlite3 through NODE_PATH ... Include everything needed at runtime; opening the finished app must not require an install or build step.' (7) Symlinks: test.sh:72-83 exits for any link outside /app/node_modules <-> integration.md:11 'Symbolic links are unsupported except links under /app/node_modules whose resolved targets also stay under /app/node_modules.' (8) Seed: test.sh:88 'chmod -R a+rX /assets', task.toml:2 artifacts '/assets' <-> instruction.md:3 and integration.md:7 '/assets/seed_data.json describes the starting scope'; seed has 'snippets': [] and no criterion depends on seed rows; app_context.md:24 tells the judge not to assume an empty library, so a database carried over from development is not penalised. (9) No sign-in: instruction.md:5 'without signing in', app_context.md:10 'None'. No judge prompt names a route other than / and /api/health (app_context.md:25), both public. test.sh, both Dockerfiles and restart_mcp.py are byte-identical to the frozen template. Run evidence: run_golden.sh:26-27 launches the golden as test.sh does (chown 65534, 'cd /tmp', 'env -i PATH NODE_PATH HOME PORT=3000 DB_PATH=/app/app.db setpriv --reuid=65534') and results/restart.json shows a record with 'revision':2,'history':[2,1] read back after a real process restart; this is in the agent image, not through tests/test.sh in the verifier image, and the only hosted run is on an earlier candidate with the same test.sh. Notes, not defects: (a) the launch runs as uid 65534 with HOME=/tmp/submission and a three-directory PATH, and none of that is stated; the public text only hints at it with 'writable copy outside /app'. test.sh:87 chowns /app to 65534 so a conforming app that writes only its database is unaffected; an app that writes state outside /app or DB_PATH (for example under /root or /var) would fail to start or persist, but the brief already fixes the storage location. (b) The agent image also carries git, sqlite3 CLI and procps that the verifier image lacks; integration.md:5 enumerates what the launch image supplies, so an app shelling out to the sqlite3 binary is outside the stated contract rather than misled by it. (c) The golden reads an undocumented SQLITE_PATH fallback (server.js:8); harmless, DB_PATH takes precedence. Weak-app probe: an app ignoring DB_PATH still passes while /app is writable, which is consistent with the stated default path, so nothing is mis-graded. Conforming-alternative probe: an app using node:sqlite or a bundled /app/node_modules instead of the global packages, with its own routes, launches under this test.sh without any unstated requirement.
